premise_lock.slide_2_job: Make the reader feel the ache of one missing person and the comfort that their place is still kept.
must_not_change: Do not add more song lyrics.
Do not make a generic 'home is a person' quote card.

shortlisted_candidates.title: Your Side Still Stays Yours
shortlisted_candidates.one_line_concept: One partner is alone in a complete room but still leaves the other person's usual place untouched; the empty side becomes proof that the house is waiting for its real ghar.
shortlisted_candidates.slide_1_text: khaali hai jo tere bina, main woh ghar hoon tera
shortlisted_candidates.revision_note: Previous slide 2 direction was rejected by the creator as fake-soft/generic. Repair must not use the welcome-back/tired-return lane.
shortlisted_candidates.first_frame_visual: One partner sits on only their usual half of a sofa or bed; the other side is open, unoccupied, and quietly respected.
shortlisted_candidates.payoff_frame: Same room, same framing, the missing person returns to that exact side. No dramatic hug; just the room finally reading as inhabited.
shortlisted_candidates.why_it_wins: It makes the lyric physical without explaining it. The empty place is a real receipt, and the second slide gives the receiver a safe invitation to come back tired or quiet.

shortlisted_candidates.title: The Door Sound Changes The House
shortlisted_candidates.one_line_concept: The house starts becoming ghar in the half-second one partner hears the other person's arrival.
shortlisted_candidates.slide_1_text: khaali hai jo tere bina, main woh ghar hoon tera
shortlisted_candidates.slide_2_text_direction: tum darwaze tak bhi nahi aaye hote, par ghar pehle hi tumhe pehchaan leta hai.
shortlisted_candidates.first_frame_visual: One partner looks up toward a door that has not fully opened yet.
shortlisted_candidates.payoff_frame: The door opens just enough for the missing person to enter the house's emotional field.
shortlisted_candidates.why_not_selected: Strong swipe tension, but a little more cinematic and less directly tied to the creator's requested empty-home ache.

shortlisted_candidates.title: Bas Tum Nahi Ho
shortlisted_candidates.one_line_concept: The place has everything, but the only thing that makes it ghar is missing.
shortlisted_candidates.slide_1_text: khaali hai jo tere bina, main woh ghar hoon tera
shortlisted_candidates.revision_note: The short missing-person direction is too close to the rejected constructed-comfort lane unless rebuilt from the raw Ghar ache.
shortlisted_candidates.first_frame_visual: A room that should feel complete but feels too still.
shortlisted_candidates.payoff_frame: The same room when the missing person arrives or is expected.
shortlisted_candidates.why_not_selected: Very sendable, but it has less visual specificity than the kept-usual-side idea.
